from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np

path = '/utils/april-attendance-data.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(path, skipinitialspace=True)
# Clean columns
for col in df.columns:
    df.rename(columns={col: col.strip()}, inplace=True)

# Parse times
fmt = '%H:%M'

def parse_time(t):
    return datetime.strptime(t.strip(), fmt)

df['Clock-in'] = df['Clock-in'].apply(parse_time)
df['Clock-out'] = df['Clock-out'].apply(parse_time)
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])

# Late arrival after 10:00
late_threshold = datetime.strptime('10:00', fmt).time()
df['is_late'] = df['Clock-in'].dt.time > late_threshold

# Work duration in minutes
# If clock-out < clock-in, assume next day; but here not the case
mins = (df['Clock-out'] - df['Clock-in']).dt.total_seconds() / 60.0
df['work_minutes'] = mins

agg = df.groupby('Name').agg(
    days_present=('Date', 'nunique'),
    late_count=('is_late', 'sum'),
    avg_work_minutes=('work_minutes', 'mean')
).reset_index()

# Rank by late_count desc, then avg_work_minutes asc
agg['avg_work_hours'] = agg['avg_work_minutes'] / 60.0
agg_sorted = agg.sort_values(by=['late_count', 'avg_work_minutes'], ascending=[False, True])
agg_sorted
